title: RAG against the machine - CLI error-handling checklist
scope: Six required Python Fire commands; realistic and important known failure cases, not an exhaustive enumeration of every possible OS/library/runtime exception.

requirements: graceful handling of empty queries, k=0, missing files, malformed JSON

exception_groups.OSError: Filesystem and model-loading OS errors: FileNotFoundError, PermissionError, IsADirectoryError, NotADirectoryError, etc. Do not assume it catches JSONDecodeError or UnicodeDecodeError.
exception_groups.pydantic.ValidationError: Data shape/field validation failures; not an OSError.
exception_groups.ValueError and TypeError: Invalid command values and library argument failures.
exception_groups.KeyboardInterrupt: User cancellation; not a subclass of Exception.
exception_groups.Exception: Last-resort CLI boundary, with detailed logging; do not indiscriminately swallow internal bugs.

suggested_pipeline: Log contextual details and exit nonzero on failure
guidance.important_note: Fire argument parsing and shell errors may happen before your handler is called. A try/except inside index/search/etc. cannot catch all of them.

index.recommended_handling: Let Fire show usage or normalize through an entrypoint wrapper; do not expect method-level try/except to run.
Show supported commands/options and exit nonzero; validate unknown flags before dispatch where practical.
Validate types explicitly at the command boundary and emit a friendly message.

index.case: Shell treats next line as a new command
index.recommended_handling: Document single-line commands or use trailing backslashes; cannot be caught inside Python.
Catch at CLI boundary, print Interrupted, exit 130; ensure resources close.

index.case: Missing Python dependency or broken uv environment
index.recommended_handling: Use uv sync; report installation error; failure may happen before CLI starts.
Log full traceback to debug log; print concise error and exit nonzero; do not silently suppress programming bugs.
Catch OSError around mkdir; include target path.
Reject invalid directory hierarchy.

index.case: Output file cannot be written or replaced
index.recommended_handling: Catch OSError around write/replace and include output path.
Report low storage/quota; clean up temporary file.

index.case: File system becomes read-only or unavailable
index.recommended_handling: Report storage failure and avoid claiming successful save.
Validate data / use model_dump(mode="json") before json.dump.
Use temporary file + os.replace for atomic output, and cleanup on failure.

index.case: Output path conflicts with input path
index.recommended_handling: Reject accidental overwrite of input dataset unless intentionally supported.
Verify data/raw exists and is a directory; rglob on missing dir can silently yield nothing.

index.case: Source directory is empty or no supported files
index.recommended_handling: Fail with clear no files/chunks message.
Handle traversal and read failures with path context.

index.case: Python or Markdown source cannot be decoded
index.recommended_handling: Specify UTF-8; choose documented skip-or-fail policy.

index.case: Source file disappears or becomes unreadable during scan
index.recommended_handling: Handle read races while indexing and log file path.
Require 1 <= max_chunk_size <= 2000.
Reject; moulinette considers overlong retrieved sources invalid.
Require a true integer and reject bool.

index.case: Chunk positions not found or negative
index.recommended_handling: Validate indices and text match before persistence.
Check each chunk length before indexing.
Handle invalid corpus; log root cause; avoid half-written index.
Catch OSError from bm25s.save and report destination.

index.case: No free space or insufficient memory during indexing
index.recommended_handling: Report resource issue; do not mask underlying cause.

search.case: Query is nonsensical or matches nothing
search.recommended_handling: Return empty results or a clear no-match message; do not crash.
